description:
The Musée Cantini in Marseille developed from Jules Cantini’s gift of his mansion to the city in 1916. It later became a museum particularly associated with modern art.

Its collections explore early twentieth-century movements, Surrealism and postwar painting, alongside a substantial body of works on paper and later artistic developments.

description:
The Musée Cernuschi in Paris grew from Henri Cernuschi’s bequest of his Asian art collection and residence to the city. It opened in 1898.

Chinese archaeology and art are central strengths, including ancient bronzes, ceramics and Buddhist sculpture. The collection connects objects gathered during the founder’s travels with later acquisitions and research.
